## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why this change is needed.

## Validation

List automated, end-to-end, visual, and hardware-specific checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests before implementation.
- [ ] CLI stdout remains terse TOON and progress remains on stderr.
- [ ] Every operation change has matching CLI, API, and CueLab behavior.
- [ ] Engine-specific dependencies and types remain inside the adapter.
- [ ] Model code and weight licenses are verified as MIT or Apache-2.0.
- [ ] No proprietary or closed music service was added.
- [ ] CueLab changes include desktop and mobile screenshots.
- [ ] Documentation and generated skill checks are current.
